name: comp-257
title: Emoji Tooltip Rating
blurb: Slider with a tooltip showing emoji for the current rating value.
description: A slider where hovering shows a tooltip with an emoji matching the current value.
use_when: Playful rating input with visual emoji feedback.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices where hover does not apply.
a11y: Emoji tooltip is visual. Ensure the numeric value is also announced.
